name: hero-carousel
title: Hero Carousel (filmstrip)
description: Full-bleed editorial hero driven by a filmstrip across the middle: all cards share a top edge, the focused card unfurls to full 3:4 height while its neighbours stay cut to half. The whole background becomes that photo, zoomed and re-graded to the item's accent colour, with film grain. A big two-line headline wipes up above the strip, with a mono credit and right-aligned meta facts (date, time, city); centred top bar (Back / brand / Menu) and a 01/09 progress rail.
darkMode: always dark; each item's `accent` tints the background
mainProps:
items: {title ('
' for line breaks), image, credit?, meta?: string[], accent?: '#hex', id?}[], index/defaultIndex/onIndexChange, brand, onBack, onMenu (show those buttons when given), autoplay, autoplayDelay, className
notes:
Fills its parent - give the parent a height (h-svh). Drag, click a card, wheel/trackpad (hands scroll back to the page at the ends), arrow keys / Home / End. Sizes are ratios of the measured stage. Fixed from the paste: broken 
 strings, hidden until measured (no fly-in on load), wheel effect deps. Default art = same Unsplash set as works-wheel.
